requirements.requirement_summary: Sync HubSpot contact lists to MeetAlfred through Zapier, adding contacts to an existing MeetAlfred campaign rather than creating a new campaign.

attributes.configured_behavior: A HubSpot list update is intended to trigger a Zap that pushes contacts to MeetAlfred.
attributes.campaign_constraint: Zapier can select an existing MeetAlfred campaign but does not provide an option to create a new MeetAlfred campaign.
attributes.reported_sync_issue: MeetAlfred still showed 68 leads after the client reported adding more contacts to the corresponding HubSpot test list.

scope.list_to_campaign_mapping: A corresponding HubSpot test list and existing MeetAlfred test campaign are referenced, but their names and identifiers are not visible.
scope.contact_count_added_after_68: Not provided; the freelancer requested this information.

ambiguity.detail: The stated synchronization timing conflicts: it was described as taking six hours and also as triggering immediately.
The visible history does not resolve why the reported HubSpot list update had not changed the MeetAlfred lead count.

execution.latest_observation: The freelancer requested the number of contacts added after the client reported the unchanged 68-contact count.
